shared_elements: bearded male figure with elaborate headdress
large feathered wings rendered in stacked rows of long feathers
arm raised holding a small object
rosette or floral element held in hand
bracelet with rosette-shaped boss at wrist
tasselled or fringed hanging elements at the hem
justification: Both show a single large bearded winged figure in profile, striding, with multi-row feathered wings, a raised arm holding a small object and a rosette-bossed bracelet at the wrist, filling the whole panel in the same orientation and proportions; even secondary details such as fringed hems and stylized floral sprigs correspond. The chief differences in depicted content are B's inscription band across the body and its added palmette/plant elements at the right, plus A's distinct pinecone-and-bucket implements, but these are variations within an evidently shared iconographic scheme.
